metaTitle: Custom Recycled PET Backpacks | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom recycled PET school work backpacks for your team. Eco-friendly bulk backpacks with your logo. Free quotes at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Recycled PET backpacks are made from post-consumer plastic bottles, turning waste into durable, lightweight carryalls perfect for students and professionals. Choosing recycled PET over virgin polyester reduces your carbon footprint while still offering smooth surfaces for screen-printed or embroidered logos. These backpacks hold up to daily commutes and heavy textbooks, making them a practical giveaway for back-to-school promotions or employee onboarding kits.
